row_matching: documents by source filename and items by source filename plus normalized item description
identity_policy: candidate-defined non-empty unique document IDs; IDs must join Documents, Items, and Provenance
provenance_policy: correct supplied receipt filename in the source-filename field plus a non-empty readable locator that identifies the item by description or a clear line, row, item, or entry marker; the locator cell need not repeat the filename or any private locator token
